title: 2017 Halftime Report
summary:
Top Reported Dirty Spot Charterers for the first half of 2017*
Now that the 4 th of July Holiday in the U.S. is behind us, it is time to make up the balance for the first half of the year. It was hard to get excited about the spot rates during the first six months, but the focus here is on the spot fixture volumes*.

children.title: Chart: Top 10 VLCC Spot Charterers
children.summary: In the VLCC segment, Unipec continues to be in a league of its own. In the first half of 2017, we counted 285 reported fixtures for the Chinese charterer, 32 more than over the same period in 2016.

children.title: Chart: Top 10 Aframax Spot Charterers
children.summary: Vitol remained the largest spot Aframax charterer, but behind them the spots have reshuffled, even though the players are the same as last year. Shell moved up two spots displacing Glencore from the runner up position.
